sentences.en: I couldn't see the lunar eclipse because of the clouds.
sentences.zh: 由于云层遮挡，我看不到月食。

sentences.en: An eclipse of the moon is a rare phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 月食是一种罕见的现象。

sentences.en: An eclipse of the sun is a rare appearance.
sentences.zh: 日食是难得一见的景象。

senses.zh: 形成日或月食；使 ... 黯然失色
